en: A sepia-toned panoramic photograph shows a European city nestled in a valley surrounded by hills and low mountains. Dense clusters of historic buildings, churches, and villas spread across the foreground and middle ground, while a wooded hill with a fortification or tower rises on the right. Snow‑capped mountains are faintly visible in the far distance. At the bottom margin of the image there is printed white text indicating the location and viewpoint.
